# README Template — Companion Resources

Downloadable files for the [README Template for Open-Source and Internal Projects](https://stackpractices.com/docs/readme-template/) article.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `readme-template.md` | Blank README skeleton with `[bracketed]` placeholders for every section |
| `readme-example.md` | Filled example for an internal payment service (quick start, endpoints, env vars, monitoring) |

## How to use

1. Copy `readme-template.md` into your repo as `README.md`.
2. Replace the `[bracketed]` placeholders — grep for `\[` to catch leftovers before publishing.
3. Delete the sections that don't apply to your project type (see the Variants table in the article).
4. If you publish to npm or PyPI, convert relative links and image paths to absolute URLs — registries render the README outside your repo context.

Spanish version: [Plantilla README](https://stackpractices.com/es/docs/readme-template/)
